articles.author: Eva Mathew
articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
articles.summary: July 21, 2026: Polymarket traders expect the S&P 500 to rebound despite Middle East tensions as earnings season gathers pace.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 slipped on Monday as rising oil prices and renewed Middle East tensions weighed on sentiment, but Polymarket traders are overwhelmingly betting the benchmark index will rebound at Tuesday’s open as earnings season gathers pace. The S&P 500 fell 0.19% to close at 7,443.28. However, the July 21 Polymarket contract implied a 95% probability that the index will open higher on Tuesday. Markets are attempting to balance geopolitical risks against a busy corporate earnings calendar.
articles._zh_headline: 股市：今天标普 500 指数会上涨还是下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 由于油价上涨和中东紧张局势再度升级打压市场情绪，标准普尔 500 指数周一下跌，但 Polymarket 交易员绝大多数押注随着财报季节加快，该基准指数将在周二开盘反弹。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.19%，收于 7,443.28 点。然而，7 月 21 日的 Polymarket 合约暗示该指数周二高开的可能性为 95%。市场正试图在地缘政治风险与繁忙的企业财报日历之间取得平衡。

articles._summary: The move is also lining up with a firmer risk tone pre-bell. Nasdaq futures are up 1.36% while S&P 500 futures have gained 0.52%. His reasoning is simple—if AI-driven price increases begin to weigh on PC and smartphone makers, or encourage new competitors to enter the market, today’s supercycle could prove shorter than investors expect. articles._summary: Micron is one of the largest semiconductor companies in the world, specializing in memory and storage chips. Its primary revenue stream comes from dynamic random access memory, or DRAM, and it also has minority exposure to not-and or NAND, flash chips. Micron serves a global customer base, selling chips into data centers, mobile phones, consumer electronics, and industrial and automotive applications. The firm is vertically integrated.

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: Ahead of Tesla Earnings, Gary Black Says Cybercab Fleet Milestone Is 'Irrelevant' Until This Critical FSD Goal Is Achieved: 'Just for Show'
articles.summary: Tesla's Cybercab fleet expansion is not impressive to Gary Black who says true autonomy is needed for investor interest.
articles._summary: In a response to user @CuriousPejjy , who talked about the recent sighting of over 245 Cybercab units at the company’s Giga Texas facility, Black said that the number of “cybercabs parked at Giga Texas is irrelevant to investors” as long as the vehicles could not autonomously drive without “safety monitors,” the investor added. “Supervised autonomous cars are not scalable,” he said, outlining that the fleet was “just for show” unless “the 245 can be driven autonomously.”
articles._zh_headline: 在特斯拉公布财报之前，加里·布莱克 (Gary Black) 表示，在实现 FSD 的这一关键目标之前，网络出租车车队的里程碑“无关紧要”：“仅供展示”
articles._zh_summary: 用户 @CuriousPejjy 谈到了最近在该公司位于德克萨斯州 Giga 的工厂看到超过 245 辆 Cyber​​cab 单位的情况，Black 在回应用户 @CuriousPejjy 时表示，只要这些车辆在没有“安全监视器”的情况下无法自动驾驶，“Giga Texas 停放的 Cyber​​cab 数量与投资者无关”，该投资者补充道。 “受监管的自动驾驶汽车无法扩展，”他说，并概述了车队“只是为了展示”，除非“245 可以自动驾驶”。
